decisions.reason: It remains closely tied to the firm's core trusted-channel identity offering and is likely inexpensive to maintain, so keeping the option open still has value despite lower visible prominence since launch.

By 2022 the market signal for a standalone mobile PDF signing function should be clearer, and if it has not become an important visible growth line it is more rational to fold resources into broader signing and identity solutions.

This architecture sits near the center of the firm's technical capabilities and broader secure-ecosystem strategy, so management would be reluctant to abandon it unless it clearly failed, which the context does not show.

A QR-based hardware token is less consistent with the firm's move toward scalable app-based cross-channel identity services and likely carries higher support and lifecycle costs, so the option value is now low.

The compliance suite still fits the firm's security and regulatory strengths and serves demanding clients, so management would likely retain it unless weak demand becomes more definitive than the current evidence suggests.
